name: Labyrinth Survivor
detailed_description:
The Labyrinth awaits. Your trial begins now.

Labyrinth Survivor throws you headfirst into a brutal roguelike FPS experience where each run is a descent into an ever-changing nightmare. Navigate procedurally generated labyrinths teeming with grotesque monsters, from shambling horrors to unseen terrors lurking in the shadows. Your objective? Survive long enough to complete the Trials, earn powerful upgrades, and perhaps, just perhaps, find a way out.

  • Intense First-Person Combat: Engage in fast-paced, visceral gunplay against a diverse and deadly bestiary. Master a growing arsenal of weapons, each with its own feel and strategic use.

  • Roguelike Progression: Death is not the end, but a learning experience. Each run allows you to unlock permanent upgrades and new weapons, making you progressively stronger for the next attempt.

  • Objective-Driven Trials: Complete varied objectives within the labyrinth to earn crucial power-ups and progress deeper. From eliminating specific threats to retrieving vital artifacts, each Trial pushes you closer to survival.

  • A Growing Arsenal of Power: Discover and equip a wide array of upgrades that dramatically alter your abilities. Enhance your firepower, boost your survivability, unlock special skills, and tailor your build to overcome the labyrinth's challenges.

  • Hordes of Nightmarish Creatures: Face a gruesome menagerie of monsters, each with unique behaviors, attack patterns, and weaknesses. Learn their tells and adapt your tactics to survive their relentless assault.

short_description: Descend into the ever-shifting labyrinth, in a relentless roguelike FPS where survival depends on your skill, your weapon, and a little bit of luck. Face hordes of nightmarish creatures, scavenge powerful upgrades, and conquer the maze… or die trying.
